mapper.sql: membership_card_types.id AS id, membership_card_types.name AS name, membership_card_types.discount_percent AS discountPercent, membership_card_types.bd_discount_percent AS bdDiscountPercent, membership_card_types.amount AS amount, membership_card_types.point AS point, membership_card_types.required_point AS requiredPoint, membership_card_types.memo AS memo, membership_card_types.color AS color, membership_card_types.created AS created, CONCAT(IFNULL(creator.first_name, ''), ' ', IFNULL(creator.last_name, '')) AS createdBy, membership_card_types.modified AS modified, CONCAT(IFNULL(modifier.first_name, ''), ' ', IFNULL(modifier.last_name, '')) AS modifiedBy
FROM membership_card_types LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON membership_card_types.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON membership_card_types.modified_by = modifier.id

WHERE membership_card_types.is_active = 1
AND ( membership_card_types.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR membership_card_types.memo LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO membership_card_types ( name, discount_percent, bd_discount_percent, amount, point, required_point, memo, color, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{membershipCardLevel.name}, #{membershipCardLevel.discountPercent}, #{membershipCardLevel.bdDiscountPercent}, #{membershipCardLevel.amount}, #{membershipCardLevel.point}, #{membershipCardLevel.requiredPoint}, #{membershipCardLevel.memo}, #{membershipCardLevel.color}, NOW(), #{membershipCardLevel.createdBy}, #{membershipCardLevel.isActive} )
mapper.update: UPDATE membership_card_types SET name = #{membershipCardLevel.name}, discount_percent = #{membershipCardLevel.discountPercent}, bd_discount_percent = #{membershipCardLevel.bdDiscountPercent}, amount = #{membershipCardLevel.amount}, point = #{membershipCardLevel.point}, required_point = #{membershipCardLevel.requiredPoint}, memo = #{membershipCardLevel.memo}, color = #{membershipCardLevel.color}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{membershipCardLevel.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{membershipCardLevel.id} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE membership_card_types SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
